input.why: No documented function in Elden Ring's sourced list. mp_center_sip normal is their dominant pattern for this control, used in 50% of 125 profiles, e.g. 007 - First Light row 270.

input.summary: All 29 unsettled controls now have a proposal or a question. One question remains open: left_joy_up (forward movement) offers the choice between their two genuinely different habits — a triple-puff hold pattern (47% of games) versus the physical joystick tilt (35% of games) — since this is a real fork in how they play, not just uncertainty. Everything else was settled directly: movement/camera/combat controls (left_joy_down, left_stick, right_stick, right_bumper, right_trigger, left_bumper, left_trigger, B, X, Y, dpad_W/E/N/S, start, back) bound to their clearest historical pattern for that job, marked evidenced where one option led clearly and inferred where the lead was narrow or reasoning crossed games. The 13 keyboard/mouse controls (kb_a, kb_c, kb_e, kb_f, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_control, kb_left_shift, kb_q, kb_s, kb_w, kb_x, mouse_right_button) have no documented function in Elden Ring's sourced control list, so each was bound to their strongest personal habit for that exact key across their full history, all marked inferred since the job these keys do in this game is unknown — several (kb_f, kb_left_control, kb_q) had close splits and are flagged as low-confidence in their reasons for easy review.
